brief.aim: The table is a transactional retail log with no column usable as a supervised outcome (Quantity and UnitPrice are per-line magnitudes, not row-level labels), so the evident purpose is segmenting customers into behavioral groups from Recency/Frequency/Monetary-style aggregates built from InvoiceDate, Quantity and UnitPrice. CustomerID is the repeating source unit, so its rows must be aggregated and kept in one partition; timestamps are only used to build static recency features, so no time columns are declared.
brief.repeated_subjects: CustomerID repeats across many invoice line rows; each customer contributes multiple transactions that must be aggregated into one entity profile.
